## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (for a bug fix: a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] Docs are updated if a tool, flag or output changed
- [ ] If a number in the benchmark changed: `bench:charts` regenerated and `docs/BENCHMARK.md` updated
- [ ] Nothing secret is included (no keys, cookies, private pages)
